author: reek
body: GPU-accelerated automatic PCB router using a hybrid topological and A* algorithm. Sorts nets by priority, computes shortest paths on a discretised grid, and accumulates routed segments and vias into a result set per net.

author: reek
body: A route request describes a single net endpoint pair that must be connected. Priority determines order: lower numbers route first.

author: reek
body: A grid cell is the fundamental unit of the routing grid. Each cell tracks occupancy and cost for the A* search.

author: reek
body: A* heuristic with via penalty. When start and end layers differ, adds the via cost to the manhattan distance.

author: reek
body: Stub: sorts route requests by priority so that critical nets are routed first. Returns input unchanged until a proper sort is wired.
